title: Palmier Pro: Mac video editor where coding agents can work directly inside the same timeline as you
description:
Palmier Pro is a Swift-native Mac video editor where coding agents can work directly inside the same timeline as you. Connect Claude, Codex, or Cursor through its local MCP server, then let the agent inspect and edit the active project. It also places image and video generation inside the timeline. it currently requires macOS 26 on Apple Silicon, and generative processing remains closed-source and subscription-only. #github #opensource 

https://github.com/palmier-io/palmier-pro
